card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables and doses
card.fires_on: A single digit token that sits inside or at the start of a multi-digit number or section number, such as 6, 4, 5 or 7. It appears in dose tables, dosing sections and pharmacokinetic or dosimetry data.

modes.label: Digit in table values
modes.description: A digit within a decimal or multi-digit value in a data table.

modes.label: Digit starting a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose amount after a bullet or indication.

modes.label: Digit in section number
modes.description: The digit after the point in a numbered section heading such as 2.4 or 2.5.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digit of a number in dose lines, section numbers and data tables.
